app_tagline: Take a photo of your medicine strip or prescription. We'll tell you what to take and when, in your language.
step1: Take a clear photo of the strip, box or prescription.
step2: Each medicine is read and checked against a medicine list.
step3: You get a simple card you can also listen to. If we're not sure, we tell you to ask your pharmacist.
reading_wait: This can take up to a minute on a slow network.
privacy: Photos are sent to Google's Gemini service only to read them.
no_photo: Please choose at least one photo.
bad_photo: That file is not a photo we can read.
